# Costa's Meat Market - Full AI Knowledge Reference

Costa's Meat Market is an authentic, full-service butcher shop and specialty market located in Davenport, Florida (Polk County).

## Contact & Location Information
- **Business Name**: Costa's Meat Market
- **Street Address**: 2169 Davenport Blvd
- **City**: Davenport
- **State**: Florida (FL)
- **ZIP Code**: 33837
- **Country**: United States (US)
- **Telephone**: +1-863-422-2313
- **Primary Domain**: https://costasmeatmarket.com/
- **Online POS / Store**: https://costasmeatmarket.hrpos.heartland.us/
- **Socials & Community Page**: https://costasmeatmarket.com/socials/
- **Established**: 2024

## Product Categories & Offerings
1. **Fresh Beef & Steaks**:
   - Picanha (Top Sirloin Cap)
   - Ribeye, New York Strip, T-Bone, Porterhouse
   - Skirt Steak (Churrasco / Entraña)
   - Flank Steak (Vacio)
   - Short Ribs (Costilla)
   - Ground Beef (Freshly ground daily)

2. **Pork & Poultry**:
   - Pork Chops, Pork Belly (Toucinho / Panceta), Pork Ribs
   - Fresh Whole Chicken, Chicken Breasts, Thighs, Wings
   - Seasoned and Marinated options

3. **Specialty & Regional Cuts**:
   - Brazilian & Latin style cuts
   - Custom trimming and cutting according to customer specifications

4. **Family Bundles & Packages**:
   - Curated meat combos and grill boxes offering bulk savings

5. **Grocery & Pantry**:
   - Seasonings, marinades, charcoal, and imported Latin grocery staples

## Ordering & Customer Channels
- **Online Ordering**: Customers can browse and purchase items directly via Heartland POS at `https://costasmeatmarket.hrpos.heartland.us/`.
- **In-Store Pickup**: Counter pickup at 2169 Davenport Blvd.
- **WhatsApp Group & Channel**: Daily updates on fresh cut arrivals, exclusive coupons, and community conversations in English, Spanish (Español), and Portuguese (Português).
- **Phone Inquiries**: Call 863-422-2313 for custom orders, availability, and daily specials.

## Service Area
Davenport, Haines City, ChampionsGate, Four Corners, Poinciana, Kissimmee, and surrounding Polk and Osceola County communities in Central Florida, including visitors staying in vacation rental homes near the Orlando theme parks.

## Languages
The website is available in English (https://costasmeatmarket.com/), Spanish (https://costasmeatmarket.com/es/) and Portuguese (https://costasmeatmarket.com/pt/). Customers can ask for Latin American and Brazilian cuts by the name they know from home; the butchers help find the closest U.S. equivalent.

## Common Questions
- **Do they carry picanha?** Yes, picanha (top sirloin cap) is a specialty. Availability changes daily; call 863-422-2313 or check the WhatsApp channel.
- **Can you order online?** Yes, through the Heartland online store for pickup at the counter.
- **Custom cuts?** Yes. Ask at the counter or call ahead for thickness, trimming, and marinades.
- **Discounts?** WhatsApp VIP group members get discount codes and weekly specials. Following and engaging on all of the store's socials earns 5% off the next purchase, shown at the counter (one coupon per customer).
- **Payment:** Cash, credit cards, and debit cards.

## Guides Published by Costa's Meat Market
- English: https://costasmeatmarket.com/blog/
  - Picanha guide, vacation rental grilling guide, Latin and Brazilian cut translation guide, meat-per-person party table, butcher vs. grocery store, ribeye vs. NY strip vs. picanha, pork belly recipes, saving money on meat.
- Español: https://costasmeatmarket.com/es/blog/
  - ¿Qué es la picanha?, guía de cortes latinos en inglés, cuánta carne por persona para una parrillada.
- Português: https://costasmeatmarket.com/pt/blog/
  - Picanha nos EUA, nomes dos cortes de carne em inglês, quanto de carne por pessoa no churrasco.
